L01.label: afflicted
L01.quote: The result has been, the person has neither knowledge nor wealth, he is penurious, wrathful
L01.note: Conclusion is in the Remarks after the cited window; also 'the person was a common man, hardly getting 100 chips a month' (line 14875).

L02.label: favourable
L02.quote: Consequently the fourth house is quite strong rendering the native enjoy the fortune of possessing his mother till his age of 52.
L02.note: Cited window was about Charts 91-96 (children); Chart 75 found at line 4680 (book gives birth time 12-30 p.m., not 11:42).

L03.label: favourable
L03.quote: The native has a generally happy married life but Rahu in the 7th, Mars aspecting Saturn adversely and associating with Kalatrakaraka Venus can give domestic bickerings.
L03.note: Main verdict happy; bickerings are a minor qualifier.

L04.label: mixed
L04.quote: The combinations are indicative of birth as well as loss of children.
L04.note: 13 children born, 3 lost (line 5936); explicitly two-sided though progeny is abundant.

L05.label: afflicted
L05.quote: The potentiality of the 10th house which would have made him a great monarch has been completely shattered
L05.note: Conclusion found in Remarks beyond the cited window (abdication).

L06.label: favourable
L06.quote: The native has a happy married life. The aspect of 7th lord Jupiter on the 7th and of Karaka Venus also on it have given the native a devoted wife.
L06.note: Chart 211 window discusses only elder siblings; the same birth data is Chart No. 12 in the 7th-house chapter (line 1638), where this conclusion is given.

L07.label: afflicted
L07.quote: Hence the native has had no issues born to him, even though married to 4 wives.

L08.label: mixed
L08.quote: The degree of wealth shown is not very considerable and is frequently acquired by dint of hard labour. ... This indicates loss due to the displeasure of the Government.
L08.note: Moderate wealth by hard labour plus loss; reads as moderate/two-sided.

L09.label: mixed
L09.quote: The Nizam's horoscope is peculiarly disposed, as side by side with powerful Dhana yogas, there are combinations approximating to Rajabhanga Neecha yogas.
L09.note: Lagna gets powerful Rajayoga yet Lagna lord weak, 'wavering and weak mentality' (line 11652); summing up is two-sided.

L10.label: favourable
L10.quote: The first house factors are fairly well disposed. The native has an attractive appearance.

L11.label: favourable
L11.quote: the native was considered the foremost authority in the psychology of sex and his Studies in the Psychology of Sex are a classic of their kind.
L11.note: Career as physician abandoned for literary work, but fame/world recognition concluded.

L12.label: afflicted
L12.quote: These dispositions indicate strides in career and lack of happiness.
L12.note: Lagna not fortified, lord weak; character praised but Raman ends 'Lacks happiness' (line 2232).

L13.label: favourable
L13.quote: it is no wonder that during Venus Dasa, Hyder reached the zenith of his political career, all by sheer ability and efford.
L13.note: Found beyond the cited window; Remarks compare him only with Shivaji for ability and success (line 5346).

L14.label: afflicted
L14.quote: The house of children is unfortunately afflicted as Saturn occupies the 5th and as Putrakaraka is in conjunction with Rahu. The general strength of Jupiter has however resulted in at least one issue becoming prominent.
L14.note: Partial relief (one prominent issue); could be read as mixed.

L15.label: afflicted
L15.quote: The native's father died in April 1979 in Rahu Bhukti of Mercury Dasa.
L15.note: Native was about 20 at the father's death; 9th lord blemished.

L16.label: afflicted
L16.quote: an intelligent hardworking lady, an M.A., B.T., who remained unmarried and died in her 27th year. T.B. was suspected in 1947

L17.label: mixed
L17.quote: the glorified position of lord of Lagna in the 9th with the 9th lord and affliction of this combination by Saturn and Rahu, resulting in obstruction of the free flow of fortunate influences
L17.note: Also 'Arishta yogas for suffering evenly balanced with Rajayogas' (line 7274); found beyond window.

L18.label: afflicted
L18.quote: Though it is 30 years since he married, the native has had no issues born to him.

L19.label: afflicted
L19.quote: the 7th lord Mars is subject to the combined aspects of Rahu, Ketu and Saturn while Kalatrakaraka Venus is equally strongly afflicted denoting Bahukalatra Yoga.
L19.note: Conclusion is plurality of wives (harem), an afflicted 7th; no explicit happiness verdict.

L20.label: favourable
L20.quote: The 9th indicating Dharma is owned by Jupiter and the 10th ruling Karma has been the centre of the beneficial rays of Mercury and Jupiter. Hence his life of simple austerity, his insatiable zeal in the praise of Sri Rama

L21.label: afflicted
L21.quote: The fourth house is moderately strong, but the lord and the Karaka are considerably afflicted. Hence the native lost his mother very early.
L21.note: Cited window was 5th-house generalities; Chart 65 found at line 4465.

L22.label: favourable
L22.quote: Marutha Yoga has considerably contributed to his social, financial and professional eminence.
L22.note: Chart 38 = Henry Ford; also 'a great engineer and industrialist'.

L23.label: favourable
L23.quote: The house, the lord and the Karaka being fairly well disposed, endowed the native with considerable intellectual equipment.

L24.label: afflicted
L24.quote: In Chart No. 56, the third house is aspected by Saturn and the third lord is debilitated in the 6th. The native is partially deaf.

L25.label: afflicted
L25.quote: These positions are enough to deprive the native of his father.
L25.note: Father died 1884 when the native was about 21; conclusion is a timing explanation of the loss.

L26.label: favourable
L26.quote: The suh-period of Venus in the major period of Saturn is an important one in the life of this native from a financial viewpoint. He was appointed the Speaker in a leading Indian State.
L26.note: Only a timing illustration; no explicit verdict on overall wealth.

L27.label: favourable
L27.quote: Consequently, it was only after the advent of the Moon Dasa (in Mars Bhukti) that he became President of the Congress.
L27.note: Legal brilliance and fame, though he gave up law practice and was incarcerated in Sun Dasa.

L28.label: favourable
L28.quote: The 7th lord Moon is well placed and Kalatrakaraka is neechabhanga, so that married life would be fairly happy.
L28.note: Found beyond the cited window (window showed the preceding poverty chart).

L29.label: afflicted
L29.quote: Mark the affliction of the Kalatra Bhave. ... These combinations lend credence to the romour that the native married five wives.

L30.label: afflicted
L30.quote: If ever there was a marital tragedy, long drawn out and with its roots extending deep into the past, here was one.

L31.label: favourable
L31.quote: The blending of martian and venusian influences gave him a sound body and a sound mind.
L31.note: Also 'In Rasi the Lagna is very strong' (line 9392).

L32.label: afflicted
L32.quote: In Sun Dasha Moon Bhukti, the native had a serious attack of smallpox.
L32.note: Only slight relief from Jupiter noted.

L33.label: favourable
L33.quote: The association of the 11th lord Venus with Mercury has given the native considerable earnings through the business of money lending.

L34.label: favourable
L34.quote: All these factors account for the queen's prolific motherhood. It will be seen that she gave birth to nine children.

L35.label: favourable
L35.quote: The native can command lakhs of rupees.
